courses.title: AI for Business Management
courses.summary: How managers choose, fund, and govern AI work. The step-by-step lessons will be filled in after the curriculum is locked.
courses.description:
This demonstration course is for management students who need to brief a sponsor, pick a first use case, and know what “good” looks like without training a model themselves.

The video below is a public lecture used as a stand-in. The step list is a scaffold: titles are real teaching beats; the lesson bodies will be written once the faculty outline is final.

Two actions sit under the video: Related enquiry (questions about the course) and Workshop (a hands-on clinic, not another lecture).
courses.youtubetitle: Integrating Generative AI Into Business Strategy — MIT Corporate Relations

steps.title: What “AI” means in a management meeting
steps.body: Placeholder. Will cover: predictive vs generative tools, what a model actually does, and how to stop a discussion from sliding into science fiction. Lesson text to be added after curation.

steps.title: Finding a use case that can survive a budget review
steps.body: Placeholder. Will cover: process pain, data you already have, and a one-page brief a CFO can reject or fund. Lesson text to be added after curation.

steps.title: Data, risk, and who is accountable
steps.body: Placeholder. Will cover: privacy, hallucinated advice, vendor lock-in, and a simple RACI for an AI pilot. Lesson text to be added after curation.

steps.title: Running a 30-day pilot
steps.body: Placeholder. Will cover: success metrics, human review, and how to kill a pilot that is not working. Lesson text to be added after curation.

steps.title: Reading the bill: tokens, people, and payback
steps.body: Placeholder. Will cover: unit cost, hidden integration work, and a back-of-the-envelope ROI. Lesson text to be added after curation.

workshop.title: Workshop: brief a real AI pilot
workshop.body:
A half-day clinic. Teams pick one process from their own function, write a one-page pilot brief, and get faculty critique. No model training. The point is the decision, not the demo.

This registration form is a demonstration. Nothing is booked until the live workshop calendar is published.

courses.title: Business Mathematics for Management Students
courses.duration: Workshop — find the most profitable mix
courses.summary: A shop sells puffs and teas. The workshop turns seven business numbers into a profit landscape, then lets you walk uphill to the best mix.
courses.description:
This demonstration course is for students who will sit in pricing, operations, or finance meetings and need to follow the arithmetic.

The video is a public lecture used as a stand-in. The Workshop button opens a four-screen lab: enter the business, hold one product still to read the slope, walk both sliders uphill, then take a one-page recommendation away.

Related enquiry is for questions about the course. Workshop is the hands-on module.

workshop.title: Workshop: find the most profitable mix
workshop.body:
Four screens. Enter a few numbers about a shop, see profit as a landscape, hold one product still to read the slope in rupees, walk both sliders uphill, then take a one-page recommendation away.

Load the bakery sample to present in under a minute. Nothing is saved on this demonstration site.
